ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels; dominant dark central region with bright lateral fields.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark central zone extending from the notch through the peduncle area. Left lobe: high-intensity white patch covering roughly 60% of the lobe area, interrupted by dark mottling at the distal tip. Right lobe: high-intensity white patch covering roughly 70% of the lobe area, containing several distinct dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the distal edges of both lobes; several prominent peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-10 pixels) visible on the outer thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized dark circular clusters visible on the distal-most white patch of the left lobe and scattered along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel dark horizontal linear marks (rake marks) located in the upper-middle quadrant of the right lobe's white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple horizontal linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular pigmentation and possible minor notch-like trauma on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'finger-like' dark pigmentation projections extending from the leading edge into the white field of the distal left lobe.
